images.name: cardamom
images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: an original ingredient photograph for the Zafri website, part of a coherent five-image editorial series. Landscape 3:2 composition. Warm ivory limestone surface, natural diffused daylight from upper left, gentle true-to-life shadows, restrained premium Indian botanical editorial photography, realistic material texture and rich natural ingredient colour. Close still life from a 45-degree overhead angle, subject arranged across the central 70% so both wide and 3:2 crops work. Entire composition filled elegantly, restrained negative space. Photorealistic, crisp main subject, subtle depth of field. No text, logos, people, packaging, frames, collage or watermark.  Primary subject: Fresh green cardamom pods, vibrant pale green and deep green ridged husks, a few opened pods revealing tiny dark seeds, a small grouping of pods spilling naturally beside a shallow unglazed ivory ceramic dish. Botanical accuracy: small oval tapered cardamom pods, never peas or pistachios.
